page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 4 physical cores and 4 vCPUs, providing a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage, and is provisioned with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the ecs.sn1ne.xlarge operates in the lower tiers of performance. In stress-ng testing, both single-core and multi-core CPU performance fall into the bottom 25 percent. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block speed of 161.69 GB/sec, which drops to 19.1 GB/sec for large blocks. Geekbench scores reflect similar trends, with a single-core score of 896.0 and a multi-core score of 1975.0, both placing in the bottom 10 percent of tested systems.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is classified under compute-optimized configurations, though its legacy Intel Xeon architecture results in lower performance density compared to modern hardware. It is suitable for lightweight compute tasks, basic software compilation, or low-traffic static web serving. The lack of local storage and modest network bandwidth limit its utility for data-intensive or high-throughput database operations.
